# New-ZbxService

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a service.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxService [[-Name] <string>] [[-Algorithm] <ZabbixServiceStatusCalc>] [-Uuid <string>] [-Position <int>] [-Weight <int>] [-PropagationRule <ZabbixServiceStatusPropagation>] [-PropagationValue <int>] [-Description <string>] [-Tag <ZabbixTagRequest[]>] [-ProblemTag <ZabbixServiceProblemTagRequest[]>] [-Parent <ZabbixReference<ZabbixServiceRecord>[]>] [-Child <ZabbixReference<ZabbixServiceRecord>[]>] [-StatusRule <ZabbixServiceStatusRuleRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A service models a business service as a tree whose status follows its child services and the problems tagged for it, for SLA reporting. The New-ZbxService cmdlet sends service.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new service back with service.get and writes it. The server requires -Name, -Algorithm and -Position; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create a service that follows tagged problems

```powershell
$tag = New-ZbxServiceProblemTag -Tag 'service' -Operator Equal -Value 'checkout'
New-ZbxService -Name 'Checkout' -Algorithm MostCritical -Position 0 -ProblemTag $tag |
    Select-Object ServiceId, Name, Status, Algorithm
```

A service's status comes from the problems whose tags match its -ProblemTag (built with New-ZbxServiceProblemTag). -Algorithm MostCritical takes the worst status; -SortOrder is required by the API.

### Example 2: Build a service tree

```powershell
$null = New-ZbxService -Name 'Payments' -Algorithm MostCritical -Position 1 -ProblemTag (New-ZbxServiceProblemTag -Tag 'service' -Value 'payments')
$null = New-ZbxService -Name 'Web checkout' -Algorithm MostCritical -Position 0 -Child 'Checkout', 'Payments' -Tag @{ tag = 'team'; value = 'web' }
(Get-ZbxService -Name 'Web checkout' -SelectChildren).Children.Name
```

-Child (or -Parent) takes service names, ids or objects, so a parent can be created over existing services. Get-ZbxService -SelectChildren reads the tree back.

### Example 3: Raise the parent's status when two children are in trouble

```powershell
$rule = New-ZbxServiceStatusRule -Type AtLeastNWithStatusOrAbove -LimitValue 2 -LimitStatus High -NewStatus Disaster
New-ZbxService -Name 'Web checkout' -Algorithm MostCritical -Position 0 -StatusRule $rule -WhatIf
```

-StatusRule (built with New-ZbxServiceStatusRule) override the algorithm: here the parent becomes Disaster when at least two children are High or worse. -WhatIf previews without creating.

## INPUTS

- `string`: Bound to -Uuid (ByPropertyName), -Name (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixServiceStatusCalc`: Bound to -Algorithm (ByPropertyName). The service status calc values: ZBX_SERVICE_STATUS_CALC_* in defines.inc.php.
- `int`: Bound to -Position (ByPropertyName), -Weight (ByPropertyName), -PropagationValue (ByPropertyName). A number.
- `ZabbixServiceStatusPropagation`: Bound to -PropagationRule (ByPropertyName). The service status propagation values: ZBX_SERVICE_STATUS_PROPAGATION_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixTagRequest[]`: Bound to -Tag (ByPropertyName). A tag to set on an object: a name with an optional value, such as env=prod.
- `ZabbixServiceProblemTagRequest[]`: Bound to -ProblemTag (ByPropertyName). problem_tags of a ZabbixServiceCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixServiceRecord>[]`: Bound to -Parent (ByPropertyName), -Child (ByPropertyName). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `ZabbixServiceStatusRuleRequest[]`: Bound to -StatusRule (ByPropertyName). status_rules of a ZabbixServiceCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.
